title: THE EMOTE STRIP SITS ABOVE THE BELT
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. The four emote buttons (V) were placed a fixed height from the bottom of the screen, while the belt grows with the screen. At 4K the strip covered the top of belt keys 2 to 6 with their numbers and its hint printed on the belt edge, at 1440p it covered the top of the keys, and at 1080p it covered the belt caption. The strip is now placed from the belt as it is drawn: just above the caption, and above the extraction lines while they show. A bandage or plate bar still sits above the strip.
now: The emote strip (V) now sits above the belt at every screen size instead of over the belt keys.

edits.replacement: if(G.emoteBar) y=Math.min(y,emoteStripY()-LH(30)-h);   // v16.xx (K25): above the strip, wherever the strip sits now
var ex0=Math.round(W/2-etw/2),ey0=emoteStripY();   // v16.xx (K25): above the belt and its caption as drawn this frame, not a fixed height
